items.item_text: Please ensure your resume and application includes ALL relevant certifications and licenses. Any applications missing these requirements will not  be considered.
Venipuncture certificate – preferred
BLS from American Heart Association or American Red Cross – required
3 years of MRI experience - required
Siemens experience – preferred

Under the direction of the MRI Operations Director and Medical Director, the Senior MRI Technologist performs complex MRI examinations using advanced imaging equipment and techniques. This role requires strong knowledge of cross-sectional anatomy, physiology, pathology, pharmacology, and MRI safety, with a focus on accurate image acquisition and exceptional patient care.

Responsibilities include screening patients for MRI safety, administering contrast media, operating advanced MRI and 3D post-processing equipment, ensuring accurate image processing and archival, and maintaining compliance with departmental, hospital, and regulatory standards. The Senior MRI Technologist serves as a key liaison between patients, radiologists, and the care team, providing compassionate education, communication, and support throughout the imaging experience.

The Senior MRI Technologist may float between UCLA Health imaging locations, participate in rotating schedules, including weekends, holidays, and on-call coverage, and may assume lead responsibilities when needed. This position plays an important role in advancing technical excellence, patient safety, and high-quality imaging across UCLA Health.
Internal applicants will be placed in their active/current career ladder.
A combination of the ARRT and CRT – required
Graduate from a Radiologic Technologist Program – preferred
A combination of the ARRT and ARMRIT (MR) – required
AA or BS – preferred
Strong attention to detail and multi-tasking abilities
You will be required to rotate to all radiology sites staffed by UCLA Health
Ability to adapt to advancements and changing technologies
Ability to identify contraindications for exams
Excellent communication, interpersonal and independent decision-making skills
Familiarity with clinical billing (IDX codes)
Knowledge of human anatomy and pathology
